elements.description: Point-in-time help from the help center: a small guide icon to put beside a heading or label, linking to one written tutorial.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The guide's title – the tooltip and the link's accessible name

properties.name: href
properties.description: Where the guide is: a page in the help center

properties.name: minutes
properties.description: How long it takes to read, in minutes – "5 min read" in the tooltip

properties.name: sameTab
properties.description: Opens the guide in this tab rather than a new one

properties.name: label
properties.description: Words beside the icon, e.g. "Read the guide"; unset, the icon stands alone with a tooltip

properties.name: size
properties.description: The icon's size against the text around it: "sm" (1em), "md" (1.25em, the default) or "lg" (1.5em)

properties.name: read
properties.description: Whether it has been read – a check on the icon. Set when it's opened, unless a tc-read-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: updatedOn
properties.description: When the guide last changed, as a date ("2026-11-17"); for `new-days` days after it, a dot on the icon says so

properties.name: newDays
properties.description: How many days after `updated-on` the dot shows (default 14)

properties.name: updateSeen
properties.description: Whether this person has seen the update – the dot is cleared. Set when the guide is opened, unless a tc-update-seen-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: now
properties.description: The time to measure `new-days` from, in milliseconds; unset, the clock's

properties.name: showsUpdate
properties.description: Whether the Updated dot shows: a change in the last `new-days` days this person hasn't opened yet

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-guide-open
events.description: The guide was opened ({ href, heading }: HelpGuideOpen); cancelable – prevented, the link doesn't navigate, so the page can show the guide its own way

events.name: tc-read-change
events.description: The guide was opened for the first time ({ read }: HelpGuideReadChange); cancelable – prevented, `read` stays as it was

events.name: tc-update-seen-change
events.description: The guide was opened while the Updated dot showed ({ updateSeen }: HelpGuideUpdateSeenChange); cancelable – prevented, the dot stays

props.name: title
props.description: The guide's title – the tooltip and the link's accessible name

props.name: onGuideOpen
props.description: The guide was opened; call event.preventDefault() to show it your own way instead of following the link

props.name: read
props.description: Whether it has been read – controlled when given

props.name: defaultRead
props.description: Read on mount when `read` isn't controlled

props.name: onReadChange
props.description: The guide was opened for the first time

props.name: updateSeen
props.description: Whether this person has seen the update, clearing the Updated dot – controlled when given

props.name: defaultUpdateSeen
props.description: Update seen on mount when `updateSeen` isn't controlled

props.name: onUpdateSeenChange
props.description: The guide was opened while the Updated dot showed

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
